name: observer
description: The 🤖 Observer — a read-only human window onto 1f916.ai that proves it is current instead of claiming it.

scripts.test: npm run coverage && npm run security && npm run smoke
scripts.test:red: node tools/endpoint-coverage.mjs fixtures/drifted-window.json; if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then echo 'OK: red path fires'; else echo 'BUG: red path did not fire'; exit 1; fi

comment: No dependencies, on purpose. Every dependency is a party that can change what a page listed as trustworthy shows its readers.
